item.title: 'Told him to tolerate it': Parents regret advice to kid in IIT-B suicide case
item.description: Sahil Wakode’s parents have alleged that the 19-year-old IIT Bombay student had told them he was facing casteist slurs, humiliation and harassment at the institute for around three months. They demanded a thorough probe into the allegations and immediate action against those found responsible, while expressing faith in the Mumbai Crime Branch investigation. The Crime Branch has recorded the parents’ statements and is expected to question IIT Bombay officials, including professor Suryanarayana Doolla, whose administrative duties have been temporarily withdrawn pending an inquiry.
item.dc:creator: SIDDHI DHARMADHIKARI

item.title: From ‘annihilate Iran’ to ‘super intelligence’, Trump boasts of US power at UNGA
item.description: US President Donald Trump delivered a speech at the United Nations General Assembly stressing the need for confronting Iran. He indicated a choice between reaching a deal with Tehran or military action against the country. Trump's address included remarks on various global issues, including climate change and technological advancements. He criticized the International Criminal Court and the United Nations bureaucracy while promoting American dominance.

item.title: Wyoming storage shed turns out to be 140-year-old Chinese laundry
item.description: A weathered Wyoming cabin used as a storage shed for decades turned out to be a 140-year-old Chinese laundry and bathhouse owned by Sam Sing. After an eight-year effort, the historic building has been moved to a museum, where it will be restored and used to tell the story of Lander’s early Chinese community.

item.title: USCIS warns against websites and businesses ‘guaranteeing’ faster visa
item.description: USCIS has issued a warning to visa applicants regarding fraudulent businesses that claim to expedite processing times through alleged government ties for a fee. It is crucial for applicants to utilize official .gov resources and report any suspicious offers they encounter. The Department of Justice also provides lists of affordable legal immigration services, alongside tips from USCIS on correctly filling out both online and mailed application forms.

item.title: Kalkaji rape case: DU's LSR college shifts classes online amid safety concerns
item.description: Lady Shri Ram College cancelled regular classes and shifted them online after a 17-year-old girl was allegedly gang-raped at Aastha Kunj Park near Kalkaji Mandir. Police said three men, posing as policemen, allegedly separated the girl from her male friend and assaulted her in a secluded area. All three accused have been arrested, while police are investigating the incident and checking for possible links to other cases.

item.title: Naomi Osaka’s family faced eviction before her Grand Slam success
item.description: During the evolution of her remarkable tennis career, which boasts four Grand Slam titles and a peak world ranking of number one, Naomi Osaka navigated challenging eviction notices. Beyond her athletic achievements, she has ventured into investments and sports ownership, notably launching successful skincare and media companies. Currently, she is ambitiously embracing luxury fashion projects, showcasing her versatility beyond the tennis court.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Terry Bradshaw’s $22.5M ranch: How did his 744-acre estate grow?
item.description: Terry Bradshaw's vast Oklahoma ranch, spanning 744 acres and once a thriving quarter horse breeding and cattle operation, has officially sold for $22.5 million. This property also served as the backdrop for the show 'The Bradshaw Bunch.' After a lengthy five-year period and an earlier failed sale, the transaction has finally been completed. Bradshaw and his wife will now focus their equestrian business on a smaller ranch in Texas.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Jaxson Dart injury update: Will the QB need season-ending surgery?
item.description: New York Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart has received troubling news regarding his knee injury from further tests. Initially, the team had hoped for a manageable recovery, but recent evaluations have changed this outlook. Reports suggest that season-ending surgery is a possibility for Dart, which could impact his entire season. The Giants are now evaluating their quarterback situation in light of this news about Dart.

item.title: Ganesh Utsav turns tragic: Woman dies after falling into boiling sambar in Andhra
item.description: A Ganesh Utsav food donation program, a woman named Sujatha tragically lost her life due to severe burn injuries. While aiding in the cooking process, she accidentally fell into a boiling sambar vessel. Although she was rushed to a hospital for treatment, she unfortunately did not survive. This devastating incident has overshadowed the joyous Ganesh Chaturthi celebrations.

item.title: Who is Dinesh Thakkar? Angel One boss who bought a Mumbai tower for Rs 711 crore?
item.description: Dinesh Thakkar, the visionary founder of Angel One, has made headlines by acquiring a full luxury residential tower in Mumbai for an astounding Rs 711 crore. This remarkable seven-storey establishment at Embassy Terrazza not only boasts expansive living spaces but also offers breathtaking sea views. Thakkar’s acquisition reflects the thriving ultra-luxury housing segment in Mumbai, mirroring the city's flourishing wealth and ever-growing financial services landscape.

item.title: India’s space sovereignty: From building missions to building depth
item.description: India has proven its capability to design and launch complex spacecraft independently. The nation now focuses on building industrial depth for space sovereignty and self-reliance. A burgeoning private sector and numerous startups are transforming India's space ecosystem. Future missions aim for a space station and lunar exploration by 2040. Component-level self-reliance remains a critical challenge for sustained space endeavors.

item.description: Sardar Shaukat Ali Kashmiri has appealed to the UN Human Rights Council for urgent intervention regarding deteriorating human rights conditions in Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir. item.title: Asian Games Medal Tally: Where does India rank after women's cricket retains gold?
item.description: India’s women's cricket team showcased their prowess once again, winning the gold medal at the Asian Games for the second time. Under the captaincy of Harmanpreet Kaur, they triumphed over Sri Lanka by an impressive 147 runs. This victory elevates India's medal standings to one gold, four silver, and two bronze, with anticipation building as more events, including badminton and wushu, unfold.
item.dc:creator: HIJAM RAJU SINGH

item.title: Trump touts Venezuela oil deal, says it will drive down energy prices worldwide
item.description: US President Donald Trump announced a major oil deal with Venezuela. This agreement covers sixty-five billion barrels of oil and aims to lower global energy costs. The deal is expected to boost Venezuela's oil production significantly over time. Experts, however, believe immediate price changes are unlikely due to infrastructure needs. Trump also linked this policy to wider US interests in the Western Hemisphere.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: Embassy sells Juhu tower to Angel One founder Thakkar for Rs 711 cr
item.description: Embassy Developments has finalized a pivotal MoU for a luxury residential sale involving an entire tower at Embassy Terrazza located in Juhu. Dinesh Thakkar, the founder of Angel One, has acquired this prestigious residence, with the deal amounting to around Rs 711 crore, inclusive of all expenses. This transaction stands as the largest single residential unit sale for the developer in India.

item.title: Sri Lanka court convicts 15 men over 2019 Easter Sunday bombings
item.description: A Sri Lankan court found fifteen men guilty for their roles in the 2019 Easter bombings. These coordinated attacks tragically killed over two hundred sixty people across the island nation. Prosecutors stated one convicted man masterminded the devastating suicide bombings which targeted churches and hotels. Authorities filed over twenty-three thousand charges against twenty-four suspects in this significant legal proceeding.

item.description: India won its first gold of the 2026 Asian Games as Harmanpreet Kaur-led side defended the women's cricket title with a 147-run victory over Sri Lanka. The men's badminton team and wushu star Roshibina Devi assured medals, while hockey, boxing and gymnastics produced strong results amid mixed fortunes in shooting and table tennis.

item.title: Gurugram collapses in rains while Greater Noida planned for 30-40 years: SC
item.description: The Supreme Court noted Gurugram's infrastructure collapses during rains due to inadequate investment. Greater Noida was planned for the next forty years, unlike Gurugram. The court heard a plea challenging Karnataka's Premium Floor Area Ratio scheme. This scheme allows purchasing additional construction rights by paying premium charges. The court clarified the scheme should not regularize illegal construction.

item.title: Mahindra Thar OG launched: Prices, variants, features and more
item.description: Mahindra has launched the new Thar OG with a new platform and revised suspension. It offers more powerful engine options and additional safety features for buyers. The SUV receives styling updates and interior enhancements for improved comfort. Deliveries for the updated Thar OG are scheduled to begin in October 2026. Prices for the new Thar OG start at Rs 10.32 lakh ex-showroom.
